title: Sierra Leone flag sighting
text: T-3684: every flag and code checks out on today's build (the first flag set was replaced in round 2). Where did you see Sierra Leone with Antarctica's flag (which player, roughly when)? If you don't remember, I'd close it.

title: Top bar skips page translation
text: T-3635: to stop the clock copies, browser page translation now skips the whole top bar. The cost: a player translating into a language the game doesn't offer sees Sandbox, World and the speed labels untranslated (hovers still translate). Keep it? I would.

title: Bypass joined to the other track
text: T-3672 (your Caracas side platforms) is fixed when the bypass joins the same track of the double as its leg, or neither. If the bypass is joined to the other track, the leg runs both ways again and the zigzag comes back. I'd make track drawing join the leg's own track there; OK to file and do that? (A terminus spur off a leg has the same problem; same fix.)

title: Track look letter and hues
text: T-3693: the sheet artifacts/trainworld/review/t3693-mode-looks.png shows today's look and three versions (A halo only, B halo plus words, C halo plus a ring a track). I'm landing C: one thin ring per track, so you can count tracks at a glance. Swap by letter if you prefer another. Hues: regular teal, high speed indigo #5a5fc8, tram orange #c0603a, bus olive; the tram orange sits near the delete colour and the indigo near the station tool's. Keep or name others?
